definitions.gloss: performance, staging, putting on a show
definitions.explanation: The act of performing or staging a theatrical production, play, opera, or similar live performance. Focuses on the act of presenting a work on stage rather than the performance skill of individual actors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{劇|げき}→劇：02713_geki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{上演|じょうえん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new play will be staged.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{上演|じょうえん}⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: This work is scheduled to be performed starting next month.

examples.japanese: シェイクスピア⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{何百年|なんびゃくねん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{上演|じょうえん}⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Shakespeare's works have continued to be performed around the world for hundreds of years.

notes:
{上演|じょうえん} specifically refers to the staging or production of a theatrical work.
